method: static source inspection, no OEM execution
finding: Original combination UI assembles modifier-down records before key-down, then modifier-up records before key-up. Earlier single-chord conversion rejected this ordering.
implementation: Typed finite native event sequence preserves order and modifier groups, normalized to Key only when re-encoding gives byte-for-byte identical records.
limits: Power, movement, scroll, extended values and unknown media are not inferred.
No physical timing or in-flight program read evidence.
Macro library bodies and ambiguous raw/UI playback encoding remain separate unfinished work.
